name: ready-board
description: ready.3dl.dev/board — nostr-login, owner-board discovery (ready-dbf) and confidential-board decryption (ready-c4b), built with Vite + TypeScript. No runtime CDN dependencies: the one runtime dependency (@noble/ciphers, for the ChaCha20-Poly1305 content envelope) is bundled, and dist_test.go proves the built output references no external origin.
